name: Moe Wars: Party Possums
source:
Devil Corp is holding tournaments to test out their new nanobots known as REN. These nanobots can protect users from harm, spawn weapons, and even give them supernatural powers. After a horrible event, Alice falls into a deep depression. But that isn't going to stop Lilly from trying to cheer her up. Learn how these two fixers met, in 1 of 3 character development storylines for the Moe Wars series. 

[From [url=https://renai.us/game/moe-wars-party-possums]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
Devil Corp正在举办锦标赛来测试他们名为REN的新型纳米机器人。这些纳米机器人可以保护用户免受伤害，产生武器，甚至赋予他们超自然的力量。经历了一次可怕的事件后，爱丽丝陷入了深深的抑郁之中。但这并不能阻止莉莉试图让她振作起来。通过Moe Wars系列的3个角色发展故事情节之一，了解这两个修复者是如何相遇的。

[来自[url=https://renai.us/game/moe-wars-party-possums]仁爱档案[/url]]
